title: Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman seeks unity to halt Awami League's resurgence
description:
Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman on Wednesday sought unity among "democratic forces" to prevent the "resurgence" of deposed premier Sheikh Hasina's currently banned Awami League as political violence gripped the country over her stated plan to return home in December despite a pending death sentence.
"These terrorists (Awami League activists) have once again engaged in acts of terror against the country and its people," Rahman told parliament as political violence erupted in different parts of Bangladesh, killing at least four people in the past two days.
The prime minister asked all democratic political parties to unite on a single platform, as they did during the violent student-led street protest dubbed the July Uprising that toppled the Awami League government, to counter the "fallen, defeated, and ousted fascist forces" and foil their conspiracies.
